Why AI-Supported Presets Change Everything

Traditional Lightroom presets apply a global filter across the entire image. If your shadows are too dark or your highlights are blown out, a standard filter often makes those flaws worse, requiring extensive manual masking.

The AI-enhanced presets in this masterclass work differently. By harnessing automated masking capabilities, they detect facial features, background separation, and dynamic range elements instantly. This means a single click can optimize skin smoothing while leaving background textures crisp, or brighten eyes without blowing out surrounding highlights. It is like having a digital retouching assistant built directly into your software.
